posts.name: bobbertoriley
posts.cooked:
Welcome to the Court of Blood episode, featuring one brief question about Bugbear and an aside on Hermetic.

 

I kinda wish, rather than always saying "Go rewatch this episode", they would start just giving a 30 second abridged summary of whatever they've already covered or just resummarize it. It'd be a bit more prudent than assuming that the listeners either remember the details from previous episodes, or have the time to go back and relisten any time they recommend getting familiar on it again. (Also, for an episode that promises to cover Bugbear, for example, there was almost nothing about the guy. Even if it was a simple re-hash.) I guess it is meta to comics to constantly reference back-issues, though. *shrugs*

 

Also, got a laugh from the show notes that Christopher/whoever wrote them felt the need to go in-depth explaining the difference between the timestamp having hours:minutes:seconds instead of just minutes:seconds. Feel like that's probably the simplest concept to grok to give that much effort explaining.

posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
I love the timestamp change, never even thought to ask for it and I'm glad someone did.

 

And, I have to say, this was defintely the court of blood episode with some highlights from some other people. Nothing neccesarily wrong with that, but we didn't even really get a lot of discussion about the hows of blood magic and why it is different from other types of magic, except that it relies upon blood which I could have told you before the episode.

 

I'm a fantasy nerd, magic systems are a love of mine and I hoped for a bit more.

 

All that being said, we now know that The Blood Countess is another major power in the world. The type to get sealed for millenia because you can't beat them. That really changes how I view her and her court, along with the offerings of power to various beings. I get the feeling she was doing something similiar to what Amit is doing now for quite some time.

 

Also, got to say, I love the stuff about the werewolves, that is some cool lore and I'm wondering about having a werewolf character in the game now, which I was not planning on before
